slides.title: Claude'ni *$300/soatlik* injenerdek ishlating
slides.sub: Kodingizni katta kompaniya darajasida tekshiring. **6 ta prompt**.

slides.title: Senior *review* rejimi
paragraphs: Claude'da yashirin imkoniyat bor: u kodingizni **oddiy mashq** kabi emas, **production** darajasida tekshiradi.
Ming PR ko'rgan senior injener kabi — xato, dizayn, tezlik va xarajatni ko'radi.

slides.title: Rejimni *yoqish*
slides.label: PROMPT
slides.prompt: Act as a staff engineer who has reviewed thousands of PRs. Whenever I paste code, review it with production standards, not a coding exercise. My language is: [language].

slides.title: Birinchi *ta'sir*
slides.label: PROMPT
slides.prompt: Give me your first-pass reaction to my code [paste], the way a senior would in 60 seconds: what's fine, what smells, and the one thing you would not let ship.

slides.title: Xato va *chekka holatlar*
slides.label: PROMPT
slides.prompt: Walk through my code [paste] and identify the edge cases, race conditions, and failure modes a mid-level engineer is most likely to miss.

slides.title: Dizayn va *chegaralar*
slides.label: PROMPT
slides.prompt: Critique the design of my code [paste] at the level of responsibilities, boundaries, naming, and what should be extracted, inlined, or renamed for future maintainers.

slides.title: Tezlik va *xarajat*
slides.label: PROMPT
slides.prompt: Profile my code [paste] for likely hot paths, allocations, and N+1 traps, and suggest changes that meaningfully matter, not micro-optimizations.

slides.title: Namunaviy *qayta yozish*
slides.label: PROMPT
slides.prompt: Rewrite the highest-impact section of my code [paste section] the way a senior engineer would ship it, with a short note on why each change matters.
